summary: Warnings can no longer push the error that failed a node out of `controlbus watch --quiet`. Before, WARN and ERROR lines shared one 20-line limit per node, filled in arrival order. Now each level has its own 20-line limit and its own "… more problem lines suppressed" notice. The change is one budget key in `problemFilter.admit` (cli/internal/commands/controlbus/problems.go), plus updated comments. A node now shows at most 42 problem lines instead of 21: 20 per level plus one notice each. I added `TestProblemFilter_warningsNeverCrowdOutTheError`, which fills the WARN limit and then checks that a later ERROR line is still printed. `./gradlew :cli:goTest` passes. I did not run `:cli:check`, which includes the 100% coverage check; the workflow's full gate runs it. The PR text is in .yukta-dev/pr.md.
